paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page background, card surfaces, input fields

cloud-gray.$description: Cloud Gray — Secondary surface, subtle card backgrounds, tag fills

mist-border.$description: Mist Border — Hairline dividers, card borders, input borders, the dominant structural line color

fog-border.$description: Fog Border — Slightly stronger dividers, placeholder text on inputs

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

midnight-panel.$description: Midnight Panel — Dark hero panel background, dark navigation wells — the high-contrast stage for the mascot

deep-night.$description: Deep Night — Deepest panel surface used in gradients and product UI previews; Hero panel and product preview gradient — subtle two-stop from slate to near-black

slate-body.$description: Slate Body — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

steel-caption.$description: Steel Caption — Metadata, timestamps, helper text, nav links, muted icon fills

ash-disabled.$description: Ash Disabled — Tertiary text, inactive icons, disabled controls, the quietest neutral

hugging-yellow.$description: Hugging Yellow — The 🤗 emoji logo mark — the only warm color in the system, appears as a small brand stamp

link-blue.$description: Link Blue — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

source-sans-pro.$description: The single workhorse family — handles every UI surface from 10px metadata to 96px display headlines. Weight 400 carries body and most UI; 600 takes section labels and button text; 700 is reserved for the largest headlines where the humanist letterforms need extra weight to hold the page.

ibm-plex-mono.$description: Technical identifiers — model names like moonshatai/Kimi-K2.5, dataset slugs, parameter values, repo paths. The monospace grid signals 'this is a machine-readable handle' and gives the interface a workshop feel.
